note: TABLET-05's hover card on the tablet chrome: a mouse rests on a sidebar row and the host draws the card (TabHoverCardView.kt, fed through chrome.hoverCard) above the live page - the placement against the sidebar's inner edge, the page's picture, the title and host line, the move to the next row without a second wait, the active row without a picture, the dismissals by leaving the rows and by a press. The hover acts run with UiAutomation disconnected (a hidden method, hence --no-hidden-api-checks), as the desktop windowing demo's: a WebView hands a mouse's hover to accessibility exploration while any service is enabled. The workflow's light act measured about 90 s of driver time on run 36335779110; the nightly runs the light scheme.
